title: Story premise EDU043: The Comma Changes the Guest List
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: How many groups did this sentence invite? Takeaway/theme: Punctuation and sentence structure help readers identify intended grouping.
description: An event host wants to label snacks for guests, but an unpunctuated line combines categories in two possible ways. Brackets and punctuation make the intended grouping visible before the labels print.
